Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Kunal - 8 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Sunita - 41 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Siya - 10 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Sunita and Siya stand near him.]

Kunal: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[A dust storm sweeps across the village.]

Kunal (happily): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Sunita: "Well done!"

[Suddenly the ground shakes.]

Siya: "That was such a fun day!"
